limitations: Requires a configured containing workspace and client documentChanges support; no unversioned edit fallback
Search/discovery exclusions and root boundaries bound coverage; external reverse importers are outside scope
Any invalid searched graph or affected unmapped identifier rejects the operation; some grouped/callback source forms remain conservative refusals
New names use ASCII identifier syntax and exclude control/type/intrinsic spellings; main function entries are fixed
Closed files use version null and can become stale after response; no atomic filesystem/apply transaction or adversarial concurrent-mutation qualification
Synchronous analysis and validation; no latency guarantee or persistent index
Rename-specific maximum budget boundaries were not independently stress-qualified
